interactions.summary: Jiang pauses the canto to recover Aesop's frog-and-mouse fable from a student summary and then maps it onto the demons, who become victims of their own treachery and greed.
interactions.speaker_attribution: Jiang prompt, student summary, then Jiang gloss

interactions.summary: The reading shows Dante and Virgil fleeing the devils, with Virgil carrying Dante down the embankment like a mother saving a child while providence limits the demons' reach.
Jiang asks why Dante includes a danger scene whose outcome is already guaranteed by providence, and a student answers that the point is comradeship.

claims.claim: Jiang reads the frog-and-mouse fable as a miniature of the demon episode: the demons try to swindle Dante and Virgil, become greedy for more victims, and end up caught by their own trap.

The chase scene is narratively unnecessary at the level of plot protection because providence already guarantees Dante's survival, but Jiang treats it as meaningful at the level of relationship-building.

signature_moments.moment: The demons become the frog in Aesop: treachery turns predatory appetite into self-destruction.
signature_moments.source_phrase: they get greedy ... so they fall into their own trap
signature_moments.why_it_matters: It compresses the whole bolgia into a fable of greed outrunning itself.

signature_moments.moment: Virgil carrying Dante like a mother fleeing fire matters even though God already guarantees the outcome.
signature_moments.source_phrase: just as the mother who's wakened ... will lift her son
signature_moments.why_it_matters: It shifts the emphasis from suspense to intimacy and character formation.

glossary_terms.definition_or_usage: Aesop's fable used by Jiang as an interpretive key for the demons' greed and self-entrapment.
A scene where threat is real at the experiential level even though divine will has already fixed the final outcome.

uncertainty_notes.note: The ASR rendering of the place-name in the line about providence is garbled, but the interpretive function is clear: the demons are not permitted to leave their assigned zone.
